results.reasoning: Driven headless at 8f32045 on scratch machines under /tmp/judge10-*, no server. The base steps hold: one home registers alone with its ID and project, a repository lists each home by folder and marks the listed one, no terminal registers nothing without --all or --only, re-import leaves the row unchanged, and paths with no home say so. The n-0543 claims hold too. A worktree imported before its checkout registers at the checkout in the checkout's project, by one home, by --all, and from a .claude/worktrees folder. A home only the worktree holds is refused once and exits 2, as are --only PROMO and --only promo,Promo. --only matches in any case, and a fork moved elsewhere keeps its IDs. n-0522 through n-0542 still hold, and so do letter case, /tmp vs /private/tmp and symlinks. It fails because a gone row now goes to any repository holding its first commit, whatever its origin. alpha (origin acme/alpha) and beta (origin acme/beta) were both cloned from one starter kit and each gained its own committed web home. alpha was registered, then moved to ~/code/alpha. Importing beta reported '~ moved ... keeps its ID 0001-ap-web', so beta's home is filed as alpha's blueprint under alpha's label and origin. alpha at its new place is then refused, 'the project label alpha is another project's', even with --project alpha, and walkdown status there finds nothing. If alpha is deleted instead, beta inherits its label silently. A person's own project cannot be imported under its own name, and the advice printed leads nowhere.
